# Pranay Kotasthane

> Public policy researcher, educator, and writer at the Takshashila Institution (Bengaluru, India). Research focus: semiconductor geopolitics, critical minerals, technology policy, India's fiscal federalism, and foreign policy.

## About

Pranay Kotasthane is a policy researcher at the Takshashila Institution. He co-authors *Anticipating the Unintended*, a weekly policy newsletter; co-hosts *Puliyabaazi*, a Hindi-Urdu podcast on public policy; and co-hosts *Watching the Wheels*, a YouTube show on economics and public policy with Amit Varma and Shruti Rajagopalan. He has co-authored four books on semiconductors, public policy, and public finance.

Key areas of expertise:
- Semiconductor geopolitics and India's chip strategy
- Critical minerals supply chains
- Technology policy and techno-strategic autonomy
- India's fiscal federalism and Finance Commission
- India's foreign policy, especially neighbourhood policy and the Quad

- [Books](https://pranaykotas.com/books.html): Co-authored books including works on semiconductors and public policy

- [Podcast](https://pranaykotas.com/podcast.html): *Puliyabaazi* — Hindi-Urdu podcast on policy and economics, and *Watching the Wheels* — a YouTube show with Amit Varma and Shruti Rajagopalan

- [Field Notes](https://pranaykotas.com/field-notes/): Short observations, quips, and insights on policy, geopolitics, cities, and the craft of research
